blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Aromatic Hydrocarbons) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain aur percentage yield ka sawal Given → formula → qeemat → jawab ki tarteeb se hal kiya gaya hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key aur numerical ka jawab nahi chhapa.
Q1. Multiple Choice Questions: (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
I. Which of the following is the major product when methyl chloride (CH₃Cl) reacts with methylbenzene in the presence of AlCl₃:
(AlCl₃ ki maujoodgi mein CH₃Cl aur methylbenzene ke reaction ka bara product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh Friedel-Crafts alkylation hai: AlCl₃ + CH₃Cl se electrophile CH₃⁺ banta hai. Ring par pehle se maujood CH₃ ortho-para (2,4-) directing hai, is liye naya CH₃ zyada tar 2- aur 4- jagah jata hai: 1,2- aur 1,4-dimethylbenzene ka mixture. Meta product bohat kam.

blocks.prompt:
II. Bromine reacts more readily with phenol than with benzene. This is because the:
(Bromine phenol se benzene ke muqable mein zyada aasani se reaction kyun karta hai?)

options.text: phenol ki benzene ring nucleophilic hamle ke liye zyada hassas hai
OH ki oxygen bohat electronegative hai is liye phenol ki ring deactivated hai
phenol ki oxygen ka lone pair benzene ring ke delocalised electrons se overlap karta hai
oxygen ka lone pair phenol ko electrophile bana deta hai

blocks.explanation: –OH ki O ka aik lone pair ring ke delocalised π nizam se overlap karta hai aur ring mein electron density barhata hai (khaas tor par 2, 4, 6 jagah). Ring Br₂ jaise electrophiles ke liye activated ho jati hai aur halogen carrier ke baghair Br₂ ko polarize kar leti hai.

blocks.prompt:
III. Aluminium chloride catalyses the reaction of benzene and ethanoyl chloride. This is because aluminium chloride.
(AlCl₃ benzene aur ethanoyl chloride ke reaction ka catalyst kyun hai?)

options.text: is mein kafi covalent character hai
non-polar solvents mein dimer ki shakal mein hota hai

blocks.explanation: AlCl₃ Lewis acid (electron pair lene wala) hai. Yeh CH₃COCl ki Cl se lone pair le kar Cl⁻ kheench leta hai aur acylium ion electrophile banta hai: CH₃COCl + AlCl₃ → CH₃CO⁺ + [AlCl₄]⁻.

blocks.prompt:
IV. Benzene is nitrated using a mixture of concentrated nitric and sulphuric acids. The sulphuric acid
(Benzene ki nitration mein sulphuric acid kya karta hai?)

options.text: benzene aur nitric acid ke liye solvent hai
benzene ko protonate kar ke reaction tez karta hai
nitric acid ko protonate karta hai jo base ka kaam karta hai
benzene se benzenesulfonic acid intermediate banata hai

blocks.explanation:
H₂SO₄ zyada taqatwar acid hai: yeh HNO₃ ko proton deta hai (HNO₃ base ka kaam karta hai), aur protonated nitric acid pani kho kar electrophile NO₂⁺ banata hai:
H₂SO₄ + HNO₃ ⇌ NO₂⁺ + HSO₄⁻ + H₂O
Aakhir mein H₂SO₄ wapas ban jata hai (catalyst).

blocks.prompt:
V. In the reaction of benzene with chloromethane, aluminium chloride is added because it reacts with
(Benzene aur chloromethane ke reaction mein AlCl₃ kyun dala jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein AlCl₃ alkyl halide se reaction karta hai: CH₃Cl + AlCl₃ → CH₃⁺ + [AlCl₄]⁻. Carbocation CH₃⁺ electrophile hai jo benzene ring par hamla karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
VI. Methylbenzene reacts with a mixture of concentrated nitric acid and concentrated sulphuric acid.
What is the name of the mechanism for this reaction?
(Methylbenzene ki nitration ka mechanism kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electrophile NO₂⁺ ring ke aik H ki jagah leta hai aur aromatic ring qaim rehti hai: electrophilic (aromatic) substitution; zyada tar 2- aur 4-nitromethylbenzene banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
VII. X-ray diffraction provides evidence that benzene molecules have:
(X-ray diffraction kis baat ka saboot deta hai?)

options.text: tamam carbon-carbon bonds ki lambai barabar

blocks.explanation: X-ray bond ki lambai aur angles naapti hai: benzene hamwar (planar) regular hexagon hai jis ke chhe C–C bonds 139 pm (C–C 154 pm aur C=C 133 pm ke darmiyan). Delocalisation is natije ki wazahat hai; stability hydrogenation ki heat se pata chalti hai, X-ray se nahi.

blocks.prompt:
VIII. Which statement(s) support(s) the delocalised model for the structure of benzene?
1 All carbon–carbon bonds have the same length.
2 The enthalpy change of hydrogenation of benzene is less exothermic than expected.
3 Bromine reacts with benzene less readily than with cyclohexene.
(Kaun se bayanat benzene ke delocalised model ki taeed karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1: barabar C–C bonds (139 pm) ka matlab alag single aur double bonds nahi.
2: benzene 360 kJ mol⁻¹ ki tawaqqo ke bajaye 208 kJ mol⁻¹ deta hai: 152 kJ mol⁻¹ (resonance energy) zyada stable.
3: delocalised π baadal stable aur kam dastiyab hai, is liye benzene cyclohexene ki tarah Br₂ aasani se add nahi karta.
Teeno delocalised model ki taeed karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
IX. Benzene reacts with an organic reagent in the presence of a halogen carrier to form phenylethanone. Which organic reagent is required?
(Phenylethanone banane ke liye kaun sa organic reagent chahiye?)
blocks.explanation:
Phenylethanone, C₆H₅COCH₃, ethanoyl chloride aur AlCl₃ ke saath Friedel-Crafts acylation se banta hai:
C₆H₆ + CH₃COCl → C₆H₅COCH₃ + HCl (AlCl₃)

blocks.prompt:
a) Benzene reacts with chlorine in the presence of a halogen carrier, such as AlCl₃.
i) Write the equation for the reaction of benzene with chlorine.
ii) How does the halogen carrier allow the reaction to take place?
iii) Outline a mechanism for this reaction. Include curly arrows and relevant dipoles.
iv) State the name of this mechanism.
AlCl₃ ki maujoodgi mein benzene aur chlorine: equation, halogen carrier ka kaam, mechanism (curly arrows ke saath) aur mechanism ka naam.
blocks.explanation:
i) C₆H₆ + Cl₂ → C₆H₅Cl + HCl (AlCl₃ catalyst, room temperature, UV light nahi)
ii) AlCl₃ Lewis acid hai: yeh Cl₂ ki aik Cl se lone pair leta hai, Cl–Cl bond ko polarize karta hai (Clᵟ⁺–Clᵟ⁻→AlCl₃) aur taqatwar electrophile Cl⁺ (saath [AlCl₄]⁻) banata hai jis par stable benzene ring hamla kar sakti hai.
iii) Mechanism (alfaz mein):
1. Clᵟ⁺–Clᵟ⁻ + AlCl₃: Cl–Cl bond se AlCl₃ wali Cl ki taraf curly arrow → Cl⁺ + [AlCl₄]⁻
2. Ring ke π electrons se Cl⁺ ki taraf curly arrow → sigma complex (arenium ion): aik sp³ carbon par H aur Cl, aur + charge baqi paanch carbons par phaila hua.
3. [AlCl₄]⁻ H⁺ nikalta hai: C–H bond se ring ki taraf curly arrow, aromaticity wapas → C₆H₅Cl + HCl, aur AlCl₃ dobara banta hai.
iv) Electrophilic (aromatic) substitution.

blocks.prompt:
b) Diphenylethanedione is a pale yellow colour, which disappears when it is reduced. The colour results from the arrangement of the delocalised π-bond electrons. Explain what is meant by the term delocalised π-bond electrons.
Delocalised π-bond electrons ka kya matlab hai?
blocks.explanation: Delocalised π-bond electrons woh π electrons hain jo do khaas atoms ke darmiyan qaid nahi balke teen ya zyada atoms par phaile hote hain, kyun ke saath wale atoms ke mutawazi (parallel) p orbitals pehlu-ba-pehlu musalsal overlap karte hain. Benzene mein chhe π electrons chhe carbons mein bate hue hain aur plane ke oopar neeche electron density ke chhalle banate hain. Diphenylethanedione mein dono benzene rings aur dono C=O groups ke π electrons isi tarah phaile hain. (Chapter se aage: yeh lamba delocalisation nazar aane wali roshni jazb karata hai; reduction ise tor deta hai, is liye rang khatam ho jata hai.)

blocks.prompt:
c) An acylium ion has the structure R-C=O where R is any alkyl group. In the conversion of benzene into phenylethanone, C₆H₅COCH₃, an acylium ion CH₃CO⁺ reacts with a benzene molecule.
i) Write an equation to show the formation of this acylium ion from ethanoyl chloride and one other substance.
ii) Name and outline the mechanism of the reaction of this acylium ion with benzene.
Acylium ion ka ethanoyl chloride se banna, aur benzene ke saath us ke reaction ka mechanism.
blocks.explanation:
i) CH₃COCl + AlCl₃ → CH₃CO⁺ + [AlCl₄]⁻ (AlCl₃ ethanoyl chloride se Cl⁻ le leta hai)
ii) Friedel-Crafts acylation, aik electrophilic substitution:
1. Ring ke π electrons se CH₃C⁺=O ke C ki taraf curly arrow → sigma complex (arenium ion): aik ring carbon par H aur COCH₃, + ring par phaila hua.
2. [AlCl₄]⁻ H⁺ nikalta hai: C–H bond se ring ki taraf curly arrow, aromaticity wapas.
3. Products: C₆H₅COCH₃ (phenylethanone) + HCl; AlCl₃ dobara banta hai.
Majmui: C₆H₆ + CH₃COCl → C₆H₅COCH₃ + HCl (AlCl₃)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Acylium ion “R-C=O” baghair charge ke chhapa hai; yeh cation hai, R–C⁺=O (RCO⁺), jaisa sawal khud CH₃CO⁺ ke liye likhta hai.

blocks.prompt:
d) Name the following molecules:
[drawn: (1) a benzene ring with –COOH and –OH on neighbouring carbons; (2) a benzene ring with –I and –NO₂ on neighbouring carbons; (3) a benzene ring with two methyl groups on neighbouring carbons; (4) a benzene ring with CH₃, CH₃ and Br on alternate carbons (positions 1, 3 and 5)]
In molecules ke naam likhein.
blocks.explanation:
(1) 2-hydroxybenzoic acid (–COOH ki tarjeeh zyada, woh C-1; aam naam salicylic acid)
(2) 1-iodo-2-nitrobenzene (o-iodonitrobenzene)
(3) 1,2-dimethylbenzene (o-dimethylbenzene)
(4) 1-bromo-3,5-dimethylbenzene (bromo alphabet mein pehle, is liye C-1)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Naam rakhne ka qaida: zyada tarjeeh wala group (–COOH > –CN > –CHO > –COCH₃ > –OH > –NH₂ > –OR > –R) C-1 par; agar tarjeeh barabar ho to alphabet mein pehle aane wala substituent C-1 leta hai.

blocks.prompt:
e) Phenol reacts much more readily with bromine than benzene does.
i) Describe, with the aid of a diagram, the bonding in benzene.
ii) Explain why electrophiles, such as bromine, react much more readily with phenol than with benzene.
Benzene ki bonding diagram ke saath; aur bromine jaise electrophiles phenol se zyada aasani se kyun reaction karte hain?
blocks.explanation:
i) Benzene ka har carbon sp² hybridized hai. Is ke teen sp² orbitals do saath wale carbons aur aik hydrogen se σ bonds banate hain, sab aik plane mein 120° par, is liye hamwar regular hexagon banta hai. Har carbon ka bacha hua 2p orbital plane ke amoodi (perpendicular) hai; chhe mutawazi p orbitals poori ring mein pehlu-ba-pehlu overlap kar ke plane ke oopar neeche π electron baadal banate hain jis mein chhe π electrons delocalised hain. Is liye tamam C–C bonds barabar (139 pm). Diagram (alfaz mein): chhe C atoms ka hexagon, har kone par H, aur oopar neeche electron density ka chhalla; hexagon ke andar daira bana kar dikhaya jata hai.
ii) Phenol mein –OH ki O ka lone pair ring ke π nizam se overlap karta hai, is liye ring mein electron density barhti hai (zyada tar 2, 4, 6 jagah). Zyada electron wali ring Br₂ ko polarize kar ke Brᵟ⁺ par aasani se hamla karti hai, halogen carrier ke baghair room temperature par; teen H badal jaate hain: C₆H₅OH + 3Br₂ → 2,4,6-tribromophenol + 3HBr. Benzene ki ring mein electron density kam hai, use Br⁺ banane ke liye AlBr₃ ya FeBr₃ chahiye.

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar likhne wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
a) The compound iodine monobromide, IBr, also reacts with benzene in an electrophilic reaction.
i) Which compound would be the main product of this reaction, iodobenzene or bromobenzene? Explain your answer.
ii) Deduce an equation for the reaction of iodine monobromide with benzene.
IBr aur benzene: main product iodobenzene ya bromobenzene? Equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
i) Iodobenzene. Bromine iodine se zyada electronegative hai, is liye I–Br bond polar hai: Iᵟ⁺–Brᵟ⁻. Electrophile positive iodine sira (I⁺) hai; yeh ring se jurta hai aur Br, Br⁻ ban kar H⁺ ke saath HBr banata hai.
ii) C₆H₆ + IBr → C₆H₅I + HBr

blocks.prompt:
b) Methylbenzene reacts with sulphur trioxide, SO₃, to form D, shown below
The electrophile in this reaction is SO₃.
Complete the mechanism for the formation of D. Show curly arrows and the structure of the intermediate.
[drawn: methylbenzene + SO₃ (S δ+ with two S=O and one S–O δ−) → (box: intermediate) → D, a benzene ring with CH₃ at the top and –SO₃ (two S=O and one S–O) at the opposite (para) position, + H⁺]
Methylbenzene aur SO₃ se D banne ka mechanism curly arrows aur intermediate ke saath mukammal karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Ring ke π electrons (CH₃ ke saamne wale, para carbon par) se SO₃ ke δ+ S ki taraf curly arrow; saath hi aik S=O bond se us ki O ki taraf curly arrow, jo O⁻ ban jati hai.
2. Intermediate (sigma complex / arenium ion): para carbon sp³ ban kar H aur –SO₃⁻ (S par do S=O aur aik S–O⁻) uthata hai; baqi chaar π electrons paanch carbons par + charge ke saath phaile hain (adhoora daira, andar +); CH₃ oopar hi rehta hai. Poora ion neutral hai (ring mein +, O par −).
3. C–H bond se ring ki taraf curly arrow: H⁺ nikalta hai aur aromaticity wapas aati hai, D banta hai (4-methylbenzenesulphonate ion, CH₃C₆H₄SO₃⁻) + H⁺, yani 4-methylbenzenesulphonic acid.
CH₃ group 2,4-directing hai, is liye SO₃ para (position 4) par jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: D ki chhapi structure mein neeche wali oxygen (S–O) aik bond ke saath aur baghair charge ke hai. Chunke H⁺ alag likha hai, is oxygen par negative charge hona chahiye (–SO₃⁻); H⁺ jur jaye to –SO₃H, yani 4-methylbenzenesulphonic acid.

blocks.prompt:
c) This question is about the chemistry of aromatic compounds.
Benzoic acid can be nitrated by concentrated nitric acid in the presence of concentrated sulphuric acid as a catalyst, as shown in equation below. The organic product of this reaction is 3-nitrobenzoic acid.
C₆H₅COOH (benzoic acid) + HNO₃ → (H₂SO₄) 3-nitrobenzoic acid + H₂O
i) Outline the mechanism for this nitration of benzoic acid. Show how H₂SO₄ behaves as a catalyst.
ii) A chemist carries out the reaction in Equation above using 4.97 g of benzoic acid.
The chemist obtains 3-nitrobenzoic acid as an impure solid. The chemist purifies the solid to obtain 4.85 g of 3-nitrobenzoic acid.
Describe a method to obtain a pure sample of 3-nitrobenzoic acid from the impure solid, determine the percentage yield and check its purity.
Benzoic acid ki nitration ka mechanism (H₂SO₄ catalyst kaise), safai (purification) ka tareeqa, percentage yield aur purity ki jaanch.
blocks.explanation:
i) Mechanism (electrophilic substitution):
1. Electrophile banna: H₂SO₄ + HNO₃ ⇌ NO₂⁺ + HSO₄⁻ + H₂O (H₂SO₄ HNO₃ ko proton deta hai jo pani kho deta hai).
2. Hamla: ring ke π electrons se NO₂⁺ ki taraf C-3 par curly arrow, kyun ke –COOH electron kheenchne wala aur meta-directing hai → sigma complex, C-3 par H aur NO₂, + ring par phaila hua.
3. H⁺ ka nikalna: HSO₄⁻ H⁺ leta hai; C–H bond se ring ki taraf curly arrow, aromaticity wapas → 3-nitrobenzoic acid.
4. Catalyst wapas: H⁺ + HSO₄⁻ → H₂SO₄. H₂SO₄ istemal ho kar wapas mil jata hai, is liye catalyst hai.
ii) Safai (recrystallisation, chapter se aage): napak thos ko munasib garam solvent ki kam se kam miqdar mein hal karein; garam halat mein filter kar ke na-hal napaki alag karein; aahista thanda karein taake khalis crystals banen aur hal hone wali napaki solution mein rahe; filter karein (kam pressure par), thore thande solvent se dho kar sukhayein.
Percentage yield:
Given: m(benzoic acid, C₆H₅COOH) = 4.97 g; 3-nitrobenzoic acid ki actual yield = 4.85 g (Ar: C = 12.0, H = 1.0, N = 14.0, O = 16.0)
M(C₇H₆O₂) = 7(12.0) + 6(1.0) + 2(16.0) = 122 g mol⁻¹
M(C₇H₅NO₄) = 7(12.0) + 5(1.0) + 14.0 + 4(16.0) = 167 g mol⁻¹
n(benzoic acid) = m/M = 4.97 g / 122 g mol⁻¹ = 0.0407 mol
1 mol benzoic acid → 1 mol 3-nitrobenzoic acid, is liye n(product) = 0.0407 mol
Theoretical yield = 0.0407 mol × 167 g mol⁻¹ = 6.80 g
% yield = (actual / theoretical) × 100
% yield = (4.85 g / 6.80 g) × 100
% yield = 71.3 %
Purity ki jaanch: melting point naapein; khalis sample aik muqarrar temperature par tez (sharp) pighalta hai jo data book ki qeemat ke barabar ho, jab ke napak sample kam temperature par aur aik range mein pighalta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Har percentage yield ke liye: (1) shuru wali cheez ke moles nikalein, (2) equation ki mole ratio (yahan 1 : 1) lagayein, (3) product ka mass (theoretical yield) nikalein, (4) % yield = actual ÷ theoretical × 100. Kitab ne jawab nahi chhapa aur atomic masses nahi diye, is liye C 12.0, H 1.0, N 14.0, O 16.0 liye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. In contrast to benzene, the reaction of an alkene with bromine does not need a halogen carrier. Compare the different reactivities of benzene and alkenes towards chlorine.
Benzene aur alkenes ki chlorine ke saath reactivity ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation:
Alkenes: C=C ke π electrons do carbons ke darmiyan jama (localised) hain, yani zyada electron density ki jagah. Cl₂ (ya Br₂) qareeb aaye to yeh density use polarize kar deti hai (Clᵟ⁺–Clᵟ⁻) aur alkene seedha δ+ sire par hamla karta hai. Is liye alkenes room temperature par halogen carrier ke baghair jaldi electrophilic addition karte hain:
CH₂=CH₂ + Cl₂ → CH₂Cl–CH₂Cl (1,2-dichloroethane)
Benzene: is ke chhe π electrons ring par phaile (delocalised) hain, is liye kisi aik bond par electron density kam hai aur ring bohat stable hai (resonance energy 152 kJ mol⁻¹). Benzene Cl₂ ko kaafi polarize nahi kar sakta, is liye taqatwar electrophile Cl⁺ banane ke liye halogen carrier (AlCl₃ ya FeCl₃) chahiye. Phir yeh addition nahi balke electrophilic substitution karta hai, kyun ke substitution stable aromatic ring wapas la deti hai:
C₆H₆ + Cl₂ → C₆H₅Cl + HCl (AlCl₃, room temperature)
Benzene mein addition delocalisation khatam kar deti hai; yeh sirf sakht halaat mein, UV light aur garmi mein, baghair catalyst hoti hai:
C₆H₆ + 3Cl₂ → C₆H₆Cl₆ (1,2,3,4,5,6-hexachlorocyclohexane)
Yani chlorine ke saath alkenes benzene se zyada reactive hain aur addition karte hain, jab ke benzene substitution karta hai.

rows: Room temperature par, halogen carrier ke baghair
Substitution ke liye halogen carrier (AlCl₃, FeCl₃) chahiye
Electrophilic substitution: C₆H₆ + Cl₂ → C₆H₅Cl + HCl
π electrons aik C=C par jama, electron density zyada
π electrons chhe carbons par phaile hue (delocalised)
Cl₂ ko khud polarize kar leta hai
Cl₂ ko kaafi polarize nahi karta; carrier se Cl⁺ chahiye
Product saturated; koi khaas stability nahi khoti
Aromatic ring (resonance energy 152 kJ mol⁻¹) qaim rehti hai

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Many organic reactions use electrophiles as reagents. Explain the role of electrophiles in organic chemistry. Your answer should include one reaction of an aliphatic compound and one reaction of an aromatic compound, including relevant mechanisms.
Organic chemistry mein electrophiles ka kirdar aik aliphatic aur aik aromatic reaction ke mechanism ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Electrophile (“electron pasand”) positive ion ya neutral molecule hai jo naya bond banane ke liye electron pair leta hai, maslan H⁺, Br⁺, Cl⁺, NO₂⁺, CH₃⁺, RCO⁺, SO₃. Electrophiles electron se bharpoor jagahon par hamla karte hain, jaise C=C aur benzene ring ke π electrons; yeh alkenes mein electrophilic addition aur arenes mein electrophilic substitution shuru karte hain. Aksar inhein reaction ke andar hi (in situ) banaya jata hai, maslan Lewis acid catalyst se.
Aliphatic misal: ethene mein bromine ki electrophilic addition
CH₂=CH₂ + Br₂ → CH₂Br–CH₂Br (room temperature)
1. C=C ke π electrons Br₂ ko polarize karte hain (Brᵟ⁺–Brᵟ⁻); C=C bond se Brᵟ⁺ ki taraf curly arrow aur Br–Br bond heterolytic tootta hai (Brᵟ⁻ ki taraf arrow).
2. Carbocation CH₂Br–CH₂⁺ aur Br⁻ bante hain.
3. Br⁻ (nucleophile) carbocation par hamla karta hai → 1,2-dibromoethane.
Aromatic misal: benzene ki nitration (electrophilic substitution)
C₆H₆ + HNO₃ → C₆H₅NO₂ + H₂O (conc. H₂SO₄, taqreeban 50 °C)
1. Electrophile: H₂SO₄ + HNO₃ ⇌ NO₂⁺ + HSO₄⁻ + H₂O
2. Ring ke π electrons se NO₂⁺ ki taraf curly arrow → sigma complex (arenium ion), + paanch carbons par, aromaticity khatam.
3. HSO₄⁻ H⁺ nikalta hai: C–H bond se ring ki taraf arrow, aromaticity wapas → nitrobenzene; H⁺ + HSO₄⁻ → H₂SO₄ (catalyst wapas).
Farq: alkene ka carbocation nucleophile jor leta hai (addition), jab ke arenium ion H⁺ kho deta hai (substitution) taake stable aromatic ring qaim rahe.
